hints.title: Boundary Conflict Mapping
hints.text: Group each pair by its larger element max(a, b) and track the most restrictive smaller elements min(a, b).

hints.title: Tracking Primary and Secondary Left Bounds
hints.text: At each right endpoint, track the largest left bound max_left and the second largest second_max_left.

hints.title: Single Restriction Removal Gain
hints.text: Removing the most restrictive constraint max_left expands valid subarrays by max_left - second_max_left. Accumulate gains per restricting index.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass from right = 1 to n updating the top 2 maximum left bounds and aggregating gains.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating the removal of each of the m pairs takes O(m * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking top 2 left bounds simultaneously determines the marginal gain of removing any critical constraint.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only the primary restricting left bound limits the window and its removal delegates the bound to the secondary left.
